back: The traditional stories, riddles, proverbs, songs and sayings of a people, passed on orally.

front: Folk tale, riddle and proverb in Shona and Ndebele?
back: Folk tale: ngano / inganekwane. Riddles: zvirahwe / iziphicaphicwano. Proverbs: tsumo / izaga.
A game in which players toss a stone in the air and pick up other stones before catching it.
A board game of rows of holes in which players move seeds or stones and capture the opponent's.

front: Give five uses of indigenous entertainment besides enjoyment.
back: Education, socialisation, passing on values, exercise, identity and unity (also relaxation and worship).

front: How did folk tales teach values?
back: The characters' fates showed the results of behaviour: greed or laziness punished, sharing and honesty rewarded.
A children's game of playing at running a home, in which children practise adult roles.
